_todo: OQ-W1C-STEP / OQ-W1C-STAGE / OQ-W1C-SETTLE: the shader warm-up behind the loading overlay (scripts/visual/shader_warmup.gd, W1c; docs/ARCHITECTURE.md 'Staged match open and shader warm-up'). Every number here is a guess for Shibi, not a design value and not a budget. The warm-up DERIVES its items from the built match (every GeometryInstance3D under the MatchRoot, hidden ones included: a draw key is draw kind + vertex format + material key + shadow casting); this file lists only what is ABSENT at match start, plus the stage layout.

stage._todo: OQ-W1C-STAGE: where the warm copies stand (high above the map centre, away from every map light), the cell spacing (one cell per light context, so a warm light never reaches the next cell), the size each copy is scaled to, and the warm camera's place behind the row.

lights._todo: OQ-W1C-STAGE: the warm lights of the light contexts (an omni like the muzzle flash and the braziers, a spot like the searchlights). Their numbers only have to light the copy in their own cell; the look of play does not depend on them.

_contexts_note: Light contexts: the Compatibility renderer builds a different program for an object lit by omni and / or spot lights (with or without shadows) than for one lit by the sun only. Each item is copied once per context. A context is used when the match holds a light of that kind (hidden ones too: the first-person muzzle light is an omni without shadows); 'base' (the sun only) always.

copy_frames._todo: OQ-W1C-STEP: frames each item's copies stay up (a particle's process shader runs on its first processed frame, its draw shader on the first drawn one). One item STARTS per frame.

overlay_frames._todo: OQ-W1C-LOADING: frames the opaque overlay is drawn before the match build starts (at least one, so the page shows it before the long build frame).

build_slice_ms._todo: OQ-W1C-SLICE: milliseconds of map-build work per frame in the staged open's map_build stage (scripts/visual/astra_map.gd build_step; W1c stage B). A frame stops starting build items once this is spent, so a frame is this plus at most one item (and the steps that cannot be split: clutter, backdrop). Only where the frame boundaries fall depends on it, never the built map. A guess for Shibi, not a budget.

nav_sync_frames._todo: OQ-W1C-STAGE: frames the staged open waits after the nav stage (the saved navmesh assigned) before the roster stage, so the engine's navigation map sync (it runs in the frame after the assignment, about 0.9 s on the web main thread, also while paused) and the roster (about 0.75 s) land in different frames, each with a redraw. At least one frame always passes. Only frame boundaries depend on it, never the match state.

settle_frames._todo: OQ-W1C-SETTLE: frames after the last warm item, still behind the overlay, before the director starts (the last copies leave, the sky's incremental radiance update and the renderer's first-time work for the match camera's own view land here).

_listed_note: Visuals that do not exist yet when the warm-up starts (they appear after the director starts or on events), each made through its own public code path into the warm cell and freed again: no match state, RNG stream, loot, prop, stat, sound or haptic is touched.

listed._why: both armour sets (data/cosmetics.json armour_sets), near and far body, squad and tier paint: a set no soldier of this match wears appears in no derived item.
a shot's tracer, muzzle flash and impact marker (ShotFx.show_shot) with its impact pool.
every impact burst kind of data/art_soldier.json fx.impacts (ShotImpacts.spawn); the pool is made on the first shot.
the debris burst of every breakable type of data/props.json (Breakable.break_now on a body outside the tree: no sound, no loot roll).

the ground-loot models, the glow batch (data/art_loot.json) and the loot field's own box (LootField.drop into a field that never places): the loot field places its items on the first physics tick after the director starts.
the zone wall, the target ring and the beacon (ZoneWall, built after the director starts).

_not_in_match_note: Shaders that no match draws in 3D; tests/test_w1c_warmup.gd accepts them as covered. vignette is a canvas_item shader on the look's CanvasLayer, drawn under the opaque overlay while it is up.
_not_drawn_note: Shaders a real match cannot draw today, each with the condition the coverage test re-checks on the built map (it fails, and the shader must then be warmed, once the condition stops holding).

not_drawn._why: MatchLook builds sun shafts only at the map's places (data/art_world_maps.json shafts_at on a terrain map), and every terrain map lists none.
